sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static content page: a header/banner, a dense row or grid of small link-like tiles, article text, and a footer area. The letter/tile navigation appears as direct links rather than a collapsed menu, and there are no visible cues for overlays, expandable sections, tabs, search fields, form controls, sticky behavior, or progressive loading. Any JavaScript beyond ordinary link navigation would be speculative from the sketches alone; the implied implementation is primarily HTML/CSS with standard anchor interactions.
